<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Publish a custom JSON on an organization"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/v1/organization/{organizationId}/anchor/json"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Publishes a custom JSON section on the virtual blockchain of an organization owned by the wallet. The request body is the JSON itself. The microblock is signed by the wallet and its fees are paid by the account the wallet is attached to.
